title: Analgesics, antipyretics and common OTC drugs
description: Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs, antipyretic and antihistamine agents, a proton-pump inhibitor and a common antiemetic, with the analgesia-relevant enzyme and receptor targets.

compounds.name: Ibuprofen
compounds.notes: Non-selective reversible COX-1/COX-2 inhibitor; the R-enantiomer undergoes unidirectional inversion to the active S form.

compounds.name: Naproxen
compounds.notes: Long half-life non-selective COX inhibitor cleared largely by glucuronidation and CYP2C9 O-demethylation.

compounds.name: Aspirin (acetylsalicylic acid)
compounds.notes: Irreversibly acetylates Ser530 of COX-1 and Ser516 of COX-2, and is hydrolysed rapidly to salicylate by plasma esterases.

compounds.name: Salicylic acid
compounds.notes: Principal hydrolysis product of aspirin; a weak reversible COX inhibitor with saturable conjugative elimination.

compounds.name: Diclofenac
compounds.notes: COX-2-preferring NSAID metabolised by CYP2C9 to 4-hydroxydiclofenac and forming a reactive acyl glucuronide.

compounds.name: Celecoxib
compounds.notes: Diaryl pyrazole sulfonamide that occupies the COX-2 side pocket opened by the Val523 substitution absent in COX-1.

compounds.name: Meloxicam
compounds.notes: Enolic-acid COX-2-preferring inhibitor with a long half-life and predominant CYP2C9 clearance.

compounds.name: Ketoprofen
compounds.notes: Benzophenone NSAID that is markedly photolabile, which is why topical use carries a photosensitivity caution.

compounds.name: Indomethacin
compounds.notes: Potent non-selective COX inhibitor cleared by O-demethylation and N-deacylation with enterohepatic recycling.

compounds.name: Phenazone (antipyrine)
compounds.notes: Classical low-clearance probe compound used to characterise total hepatic oxidative capacity.

compounds.name: Diphenhydramine
compounds.notes: Brain-penetrant H1 inverse agonist with substantial muscarinic antagonism; a CYP2D6 substrate and inhibitor.

compounds.name: Loratadine
compounds.notes: Carbamate prodrug converted by CYP3A4 and CYP2D6 to the active carboxylic acid desloratadine.

compounds.name: Cetirizine
compounds.notes: Zwitterionic carboxylic acid metabolite of hydroxyzine; largely renally excreted unchanged with low brain penetration.

compounds.name: Omeprazole
compounds.notes: Acid-activated prodrug that forms a covalent disulfide with cysteines of gastric H+/K+-ATPase; a CYP2C19 substrate and CYP2C19 inhibitor.

compounds.name: Famotidine
compounds.notes: Polar guanidinothiazole cleared mainly by renal excretion with minimal cytochrome P450 involvement.

compounds.name: Ondansetron
compounds.notes: Selective 5-HT3 antagonist metabolised by CYP1A2, CYP2D6 and CYP3A4 and associated with QT interval prolongation.

compounds.name: Loperamide
compounds.notes: P-glycoprotein efflux normally keeps it out of the brain, so central effects appear only at supratherapeutic exposure or with transporter inhibition.

compounds.name: Dextromethorphan
compounds.notes: O-demethylated by CYP2D6 to dextrorphan, so exposure varies widely with CYP2D6 phenotype.
